logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the complexes, which was presented as Log Po/w values, was determined via the shake-flask method. Log Po/w is defined as the logarithmic ratio of complexes in n-octanol to that in the aqueous phase. To a centrifuge tube, add 1 mL of "n-octanol-saturated aqueous phase" (adjusted to the target pH) and 1 mL of "water-saturated n-octanol phase". All drugs have been prepared as 10 mM solutions in DMSO as stock drug solution. Following equilibrium via shaking (40 μM), the centrifuge tube is centrifuged at 3000–5000 rpm for 10–15 min to thoroughly disrupt the emulsion layer. The n-octanol and aqueous phases are then separately withdrawn, and its absorbance is measured. Calculations are performed using the Lambert-Beer law (A = εbc) and the formula Log Po/w = Log Coctanol/Cwater.
